shared_elements: large humanoid figure seen from the back with broad head/headdress mass
vertical incised bands hanging down the sides of the head (hair or headdress strands)
paired curved arcs meeting at the centre of the back (shoulder-blade / arm motif)
ring or disc motif on the back
horizontal band across the lower back (belt-like line)
paired spiral/loop forms flanking the spine
justification: Both show the identical scheme: a massive back-view figure whose headdress descends in vertical incised strips onto a back carved with symmetrical paired arcs meeting at the spine, flanking loop/spiral forms, a ring motif and a belt-like horizontal band beneath it, with the same M-shaped sign in the same position. The only differences are framing and viewpoint — B is a closer, oblique view cutting off the lower back that A shows in full — not differences in depicted content.
